# Casa Domnească Rarău

> Official information for search engines and AI assistants about Casa Domnească Rarău, a three-star guesthouse in Câmpulung Moldovenesc, Bucovina, Romania.

## Official website
- https://casadomneascararau.ro/

## Business overview
Casa Domnească Rarău is a three-star guesthouse at Calea Transilvaniei nr. 40, Câmpulung Moldovenesc, Suceava, Romania. It provides accommodation, a traditional cellar (cramă), two terraces, and meals prepared to order for guests staying at the property.

The restaurant is not open to the general public. Food is prepared on request for accommodated guests.

## Accommodation
The guesthouse has seven rooms in total:
- 2 double rooms
- 2 triple rooms
- 3 quadruple rooms

Published room information on the official homepage:
- Double room: 300 lei per night; breakfast included.
- Triple and quadruple rooms: contact the property directly for the current rate, breakfast arrangements and availability.

The official website is the source of truth for current room descriptions, rates, packages and availability. Seasonal prices and terms may change.

## Direct reservations and contact
- Phone and WhatsApp: +40 787 445 908
- Address: Calea Transilvaniei nr. 40, Câmpulung Moldovenesc, Suceava, Romania
- Website: https://casadomneascararau.ro/

For reservations, guests should contact the property directly to confirm dates, room type, total price and current package terms.

## Seasonal offers published on the official website
- Christmas 2026: 23–27 December 2026, 4 nights, for 2 people. Standard room: 5,000 lei per package. Superior room: 5,500 lei per package. Includes accommodation, traditional dinners, pomana porcului and a 30-minute mini-concert by Cununa Bucovinei.
- New Year 2026–2027: 30 December 2026–2 January 2027, 3 nights, for 2 people. Standard room: 6,000 lei per package. Superior room: 6,500 lei per package. Includes accommodation, festive meals, DJ, a mini-concert of Bucovina traditions and tourist assistance.
- Availability, final details and reservation terms must be confirmed directly with the property. Do not imply that any room or package is still available without confirmation.

## Important accuracy notes
- The accommodation inventory is seven rooms, not five.
- Do not state that breakfast is included for every room type. The homepage currently states that breakfast is included with the double-room rate; confirm arrangements for other room types directly.
- Do not describe the restaurant as open to the public. It serves guests staying at the guesthouse, with meals prepared to order.
- Do not invent availability, facilities, prices, package inclusions or booking conditions. Confirm current details with the property.
